book.name: Jone
book.title: WAI PII EPE JONEME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Pii Doko Akali Jiamo Doko
Yuupa kaitipa dolapo nasiamopa, Pii doko wambao katea-pyaa. Pii doko Gotepa tole kateambi-pyaa. Pii doko baa Gote.
Yuupa kaitipa dolapo nasiamopa, Pii doko Gotepa tole kateambi-pyaa.
Pii dokonya-kaita Goteme dupa pitaka ipao sina lea-pyaa. Silyamo dupa pitakanya mendaipi mende kaitini waka mendenya-kaita ipao nasia-pyaa.
Lete katenge doko Pii doko-kisa sia-pyaa. Lete katenge dokome endakali dupa pitaka tii pisia-pyaa.
Tii pipae dokome iminjetae dokonya tii pisilyamopa, iminjetae dokome tii pipae doko ita naminingi.
Goteme akali mende epena leamopa ipao katea. Akali dokonya kenge doko Jone lenge.
Tii pisingi akali doko endakali dupa pitakame tungi pina lao, Joneme tii pipae doko lao panalanya epea.
Jone baa tii pipae doko daa. Baame tii pipae doko lao panalanya epea.
Endakali pitaka tii pisingi tii pipae angi doko isa yuu dakenya ipatea.
Goteme baa minatala yuu doko pyoo injia-pyaa. Dopaka doko, tii pipae doko isa yuu dakenya kateamopa, isa yuu dakenya endakali dupame baa doko-lamo lao nakandeami.
Baanya yuu dokonya baa epeamopa, baanya tata dupame baa lanyala naeyami.
Dopaka doko, baa lanyepala baanya kenge dokonya tungi piami endakali dupa Goteme baanya wane jina lao baame yakana lea.
Gotenya wane jiami doko, endakalinya taeyokopi, yongenya pyoani kaengepi, akalinya auu kaengepi, dupanya mendeme daa, Gotenya auu kaenge dokome dupa wane jina lea.

Pii doko endakali jetala, baa naimanya kainanya katea. Kateamopa naimame baanya tii pipae doko kandeama. Takange Gotenya Ikiningi mendai iki doko-kisa tii pipae doko singi. Kondo kaenge dokopa, kiningi pii dokopa, dolapo Takange Gotenya Ikiningi mendai iki doko-kisa tumbao epeamopa kandeama.
Joneme wii lao, “ ‘Akali nambanya maitanya epelyamo doko namba ipa naeyopa baa ipatea. Namba namandengesa baa katea-pyaana’ lapu doko akali dake lao lapuna” lao, lao panea.
Baa kondo kaengeme tumbatae dokome naima pitaka kaitini longonya auu pisilyamo.
Loo dupa Goteme Mosesa-kisa maiya-pyaa. Dopaka doko, kondo kaenge dokopa, kiningi pii dokopa, dolapo Jisasa Kraisa-kisa epea.
Yuu mendaipi mende endakali mendeme Gote nakandea. Gotenya Ikiningi mendai iki, baa Takangepa tole katenge dokome Gote baa dopalena lao, lao panea.
Jone Kaimbu Pingi Doko Apipi Lao Tipa Piamino Doko
Juu dupame Jerusalema katao prisapi, Lipaipi mendapuame Jone baa apipi lao tipa pyoo sala pena leaminopa, Joneme lao panao,
“Namba Kraisa doko daana” lao yapae napyoo panao lea.

Dopa leamopa dokaitame baa tipa pyoo, “Emba Kraisa doko daa-tamo doko, emba Ilaijape?” leami. Dopa leaminopa baame lao pituu, “Namba doko daana” lea. Dokopa dokaitame lao pituu, “Emba propeta mende ipatana latae dokope?” leami. Dopa leaminopa baame yanu pyao, “Namba doko daakana” lea.
Dopa leamopa dokaitame baa lamaiyoo, “Emba api? Naima tipa pyoo sala ipupa lamino dupa lamaimana, emba apina lelyepe?” leami.

Dokopa baame lao pituu, “ ‘Akali mende endakali napalenge yuu dokonya katapala wii lao, “Kamongonya kaitini doko tolasakamaiyepape” lao katatana’ lao, propeta Aisaiyame leana lapae singi doko nambana” lea.
(Jone tipa piami akali dokaita Parasi dupame epena leaminopa epeami.)
Dokaitame baa tipa pyoo, “Emba Kraisapi, Ilaijapi, propeta mende ipatana latae dokopi, dutupanya mende daa-lumu doko, embame aipuma endakali dupa kaimbu pingipi?” leami.
Dokopa Joneme dokaitanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Nambame endakali dupa endakimi kaimbu pilyo. Dopaka doko, akali mende nyakamanya kainanya kalyamo doko nyakamame nakandengema.
Nambanya maitanya akali epelyamo lelyo doko namba namandengesa baa wamba-waka katea-pyaa. Baanya moko pee dolaponya nambame kende tata lakamaiyanya, namba epe daana” lea.
Endaki Jodane omotena Joneme kaimbu pyao kateamo, yuu Betani dokonya dupa pia.
Gotenya Sipisipi Ŋaŋa Doko
Yuu gii mende dokonya, Jisasa epeamo kandatala Joneme lao pituu, “Isa yuu dakenya endakali dupa pitakanya koo dupa nyoo nepenge, Gotenya Sipisipi Ŋaŋa doko epelyamona kanjepa.
Akali doko lao nambame lao pituu, ‘Akali mende nambanya maitanya epelyamo doko namba ipa naeyopa baa ipatea. Namba namandengesa baa katea-pyaana’ lapu doko, akali dake lao lapu.
Nambame baa akali doko-lamo lao nakandeo. Israele dupame baa akali doko-lamo lao kandena lao nambame endakimi kaimbu pyala epeona” lea.
Dopa latala Joneme panao lao pituu, “Spirita doko kaiti-kisa katao, yaka maiyolee joo lanao ipao akali doko-kisa peteamo kandeo.

Nambame baa akali dokona lao kanja naeyo. Dopaka doko, endakimi kaimbu pyakamaiya puu lea Akali dokome namba langyoo, ‘Spirita doko lanao ipao akali mende-kisa pititamopa kandate akali dokome endakali dupa Oli Spiritame kaimbu pyakamaitana’ lea.
Nambame baa kandatala, akali doko Gote Ikiningi dokona lao, lao panelyona” lea.
Disaipolo Tee Pyao Nyiamo Doko
Yuu gii mende dokonya Jone baanya disaipolo lapoma-pipa dee ipao kateami.
Kateaminopa Jisasa ipao peamo kandatala Joneme lao pituu, “Akali doko baa Gotenya Sipisipi Ŋaŋa dokona kanjepa” lea.
Baame leamo doko sepala, disaipolo dolapome Jisasa watao peambi.
Dokopa Jisasa kapilyetala, akali dolapome baa watao epeambino kandatala lamaiyoo,
lea. Dopa leamopa dolapome baa lamaiyoo, “Rabae, emba anja palengepe?” leambi. (Rabae dokonya tenge doko, Mana lenge.)
Dopa leambinopa baame dolapo lamaiyoo,
lea. Dopa leamopa dolapo pupala, baanya palenge anda doko kandatala, alemandi 4 kilokopi mende leamosa, yuu gii doko baa-pipa kateami.
Joneme leamo doko sepala Jisasa watao peambi akali dolaponya mende doko, Saimone Pita kaiminingi Andru.
Andruame wambao baanya kaiminingi Saimone kutao kandatala baa lamaiyoo, “Nalimbame Mesaeya doko kandatalambanona” lea. (Mesaeya dokonya tenge doko, Kraisa.)
Dopa latala baame Saimone laminao Jisasa katea dokonya pea. Dokopa Jisasame baa kandatala lao pituu,

content.text: “Emba Saimone, Jona ikiningi. Emba kenge Sipasa latamina”

content: lea. (Sipasa dokonya tenge doko, Pita.)
Pilipapa Natanielepa Dolapo Epena Leamo Doko
Yuu gii mende dokonya Jisasa baa Galali yuu dokonya patoo lao pea. Pupala, Pilipa kandao nyepala baa lamaiyoo,
lea.
(Pilipa baa Betsaida tange. Andruapa, Pitapa dolapo siti dokonyaka tange.)

Pilipame Nataniele kandao nyepala baa lamaiyoo, “Mosesanya loo bukupi, propeta dupame pepa piamipi, dupanya akali mende ipatana lao pepa pyapae singi akali doko naimame kanjemano. Akali doko baa Nasarete tange Josepe ikiningi Jisasa dokona” lea.
Dopa leamopa Natanieleme baa lamaiyoo, “Dopale epe mende Nasarete dokonya kapa pao pyakalyetape?” lea. Dokopa Pilipame baa lamaiyoo, “Kanja ipu” lea.
Dopa lateamopa, Jisasa katea dokonya Nataniele epeamo kandatala, Jisasame baa lao dapa lea:

content.text: “Endakali minakasala naenge, kiningi Israele dake kanjepa”

content: lea.
Dokopa Natanieleme baa lamaiyoo, “Aipa petala embame namba kandengepe?” lea. Dopa leamopa Jisasame baanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo,

content.text: “Pilipame emba ipu laa naeyamupa, emba piki ita tenge mendenya katapino kanjona”

content: lea.
Dokopa Natanieleme baanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Mana Lenge, emba Gote Ikiningi, Israelemanya kiŋi dokona” lea.
Dokopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nambame emba piki ita tenge dokonya katapinopa kanjona lelyo dokonya, embame namba tungi pilyipi? Nambame emba kanjona lelyo doko ita minao kalai etete andake mendapu kanjapenona”

content: lea.
Dopa latala Jisasame lao pituu,

content.text: “Nambame nyakama etete kiningi langilyo: Kaiti doko lumbapae setamopa, Akalinya Ikiningi doko-kisa Gotenya enjele dupa lalyoo lanao pyoo katataminopa nyakamame kandatamina”

content: lea.
